# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.4.x   | ✅ Yes             |
| < 0.4   | ❌ No              |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within drift, please send an email to **sajjadbzrn@gmail.com**. All security vulnerabilities will be promptly addressed.

**Please do NOT report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.**

### What to include

- A description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce the issue
- Potential impact
- Any suggested fix (if applicable)

### Response timeline

- **Acknowledgment**: Within 48 hours
- **Initial assessment**: Within 1 week
- **Fix & release**: Depends on severity, typically within 2 weeks for critical issues

## Security Best Practices

- Always download drift from [official releases](https://github.com/sajjadbzrn/drift/releases/latest) or [drift.ir](https://drift.ir)
- Enable automatic updates in Settings → Updates
- Verify downloaded files using the provided checksums
